# G502 X PLUS through the LIGHTSPEED receiver (USB 046D:C547, device index 1),
# captured 2026-11-20 with hidapi 2.6.7 by a throwaway program reading both
# HID++ collections. A profile switch to 2 and back to 1, each as setOnboardMode(1),
# setCurrentProfile, getCurrentProfile. After the switch to profile 2 the device
# sent an unsolicited notification (feature index 0x09, function 1, software ID 0)
# before the getCurrentProfile request.
